source: Authored for the hybrid on the legacy shortage template schema (godot_project/content/source/quests/shortage/*.json). Placeholder wording: no named-character canon (D19). Version 2 (12 Oct 2026): D22 made mineral sites inexhaustible, so the cause is a real gallery collapse (disruption.py), not a used-up vein.

required_cause.detail: A working mine's gallery has caved in (a real closure: no output until timber props are delivered and the faction digs it out, or the wizard reopens the old way in); the workplaces that need its ware stall.

binding.competing_cost: Another quest elsewhere may be waiting while the wizard is underground.
binding.era_continuity: The cause rebinds to the successor mine after an ordinary era transition.

effects.note: the warden's code was broken: the old gallery bypasses the fall and the mine reopens at once
casts ran out: the wizard shows the miners a shorter way through; the faction's dig-out needs only two more minutes once the props are there

abandon_route.note: the miner remembers; the shortage persists
